candidate_limitations: Recorded manifest SHA equality is not a new byte verification; all candidate inodes must be SHA-read before execution.
Stat snapshot is not an execution manifest and may become stale.
Potential release excludes directory/journal overhead, so actual free-space delta differs.
Sources were top-level artifact-binding records; older previous-binding captures are not included.
Four groups use already shared readonly canonical files: preserve their contents/mode; new links increment canonical nlink.
Twenty GiB reserve is not reached by this candidate set.
safe_execution_protocol: Freeze a new finite candidate manifest and source-manifest SHA; reject any path escaping exact e2e source, symlink, changed stat, mount change, active writer, or unexpected target nlink.
Read/hash each unique candidate inode, require size/SHA equal to original artifact-binding and stable pre/post read metadata. Do not read model or reference.
For independent canonical nlink1 only, journal original mode then remove writable bits. For existing readonly shared canonical do not chmod or write content.

For each target nlink1, append/fsync journal; create hardlink at new adjacent temp path then atomically replace original target and fsync containing directory. Never copy over an existing shared inode.

Verify original path bytes SHA/length through canonical and link identities; preserve original source manifests byte-for-byte. Keep fresh metadata, journal, candidates, source-manifest copies/hashes and summary.
Declare inode/mode/mtime/nlink changes; do not claim per-path metadata unchanged or infer runtime quality/performance.
restoration: Need free capacity equal to materialized independent copies.
For each path, create separate new temporary file copied from the shared readonly artifact; SHA/length verify.
Apply original per-path mode and mtime from preserved preflight to the new private inode; atomically replace the alias. Never chmod/write the existing shared inode.

existing_tools.why_not_directly_reusable: Fixed historical roots, old source identities and inventory with no command-line isolation; executes top-level mutation. Adapt a new finite audited script, never run the template as-is.
existing_tools.old_compression_not_selected: docs/EVIDENCE_STORAGE.md permits original-path-changing gzip only for newly generated final-consumed evidence. Existing frozen numerical manifests bind original paths; compression would need a separately authorized archival contract. Mirror-recycle known finite compression candidates already exhausted.

capture_weight_exclusion_reason: Large historical capture directories hold multiple stored weight copies. They are evidence under .q4t-work, not model directory, but this audit excludes their payloads under the no-model-payload-read boundary. Their stat-only size is not proof they can be removed.
